name: [🎃] "EB" Brazilian Army [2]
desc:
🎧 Boombox Hangout is the place for real music, especially FUNK.
If you enter Roblox already procuring a sound to be smooth or to animate the dawn, this game is for you.

🔴Here the idea is simple:
enter, put a funk, and make new friendships
It has mandolin funk, automotive, conscious, trap, rap and other styles as well.
It's that kind of game that you enter "just to listen to a song" and when you see it, it's been hours.

- Stay exchanging ideas with the jail
- Listen to your favorite music
- Show your style
- Meet new people

#BoomboxHangout #BBH #BoomboxGame #HangoutCommunity
